dict.string: Oneova uses your microphone for Wispr AI voice dictation, live voice commands, and studio calls.
Oneova uses speech recognition for real-time Wispr voice typing and agent instructions.
Oneova Computer Agent uses Apple Events to automate macOS apps, windows, and studio workflows at your request.
Oneova uses your camera for live streaming, video calls, and visual agent context.
Oneova captures your displays and app windows so you can view and control all connected screens remotely and let Ova assist with on-screen work.
Oneova Desktop Agent accesses your Desktop folder when you ask it to read, edit, or organize files.
Oneova Desktop Agent accesses your Documents folder when you ask it to work with project files and scripts.
Oneova Desktop Agent accesses your Downloads folder to manage downloaded media, LUTs, and files.
Oneova Desktop Agent accesses external drives and SD cards to read, back up, or edit your studio media.
Oneova Desktop Agent accesses mounted network storage when you inspect or edit remote project files.
Oneova Desktop Agent accesses your Photo Library when you ask it to import or edit photos and clips.
Oneova uses your local network for ultra-low-latency phone-to-computer streaming and control.
